_comment: Exceptions tools/help_audit.py accepts, each with its reason. A new collision, gate or uncovered command fails the audit until it is fixed or listed here.

intended_gates.cc: Castle chat: the command is open to all, but only a castle member can use it, and the topic stays at level 10 as the owner kept it (ALLOWED_GATES in tests/test_help_keywords.py).
intended_gates.cgos: The same castle chat channel as CC.
intended_gates.-: The same castle chat channel as CC.

angel.why: The level 65 rank page (ANGEL) for staff of that rank; everyone else gets Herbie the angel.

herbie.why: HERBIE is a staff command; mortals get the page about Herbie himself.

hero.why: HERO is the heroes' channel from level 51; below that the word means hero levels.

invis.why: INVIS is WIZINVIS for staff; mortals get the spell, staff reach it as INVISSPELL.

teleport.why: TELEPORT is TRANSFER for staff; mortals get the spell, staff reach it as TELEPORTSPELL.

empower.why: The staff command; players get the bundle's effects, staff reach them as EMPOWER SPELL.

titanic.why: The staff command; players get the bundle's effects, staff reach them as TITANIC SPELL.

farslay.why: The implementors' FARSLAY command; everyone else gets the quest master's scroll (SCROLL OF FARSLAY).

goblin.why: The staff GOBLIN command; everyone else gets the treasure goblin (TREASURE GOBLIN).

hermie.why: Players ask for BUFF/HERMIE; the staff page is reached by its command, SPELLUP.

_distinct_pages_comment: Keyword pairs where one is a stem of the other (WORD and WORDS, a command and its skill's whole name) that tools/help_audit.py would otherwise read as one command split over two pages. Key: '<shorter> / <longer>', lower case.

distinct_pages.new / news: NEW is the settings overview (NEW SETTINGS CUSTOMIZE OPTIONS); NEWS is the game's news, which the NEWS command shows. No NEW command exists.
distinct_pages.scroll / scrolls: SCROLL is the scroll-back command; SCROLLS names the item type on the wands, staves and scrolls page.
distinct_pages.psionic / psionics: PSIONIC is the psionic armor power's command; PSIONICS is the overview of every psionic power.
distinct_pages.kill / killer: KILL is the attack command; KILLER is the old name for the WANTED flag and is kept as a keyword on the WANTED page.

_staff_commands_public_help_comment: Commands at LEVEL_IMMORTAL or above whose page every mortal may read on purpose: the word is also a public topic and the staff command has its own page under another keyword.

staff_commands_public_help.oracle: ORACLE is the Oracle herself for players (PRAY, ASK); the staff command's page is ORACLEADMIN / 'ORACLE ADMIN'.

_reference_aliases_comment: See also destinations and advertised HELP topics accepted although they do not reach a page by its exact keyword, each with why. Key: the destination, lower case.
